name: Exp_PriceChannel_Stop
summary: This EA trades based on the PriceChannel_Stop custom indicator, opening buy positions when the upper channel signal triggers and sell positions when the lower channel signal triggers. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and implements both entry and exit signals from the indicator's multiple buffers.
summary_zh: 该EA基于PriceChannel_Stop自定义指标进行交易，当上轨信号触发时开多仓，下轨信号触发时开空仓。它采用可配置的资金管理系统，支持多种保证金模式，并利用指标的多个缓冲区实现入场和出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于价格通道突破，使用PriceChannel_Stop指标识别趋势方向变化。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 3）出现非空值时触发做多信号，当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现非空值时触发做空信号。出场条件包括：做多信号触发时同时平空仓，做空信号触发时同时平多仓，此外还利用指标的辅助缓冲区（buffer 4和buffer 1）进行额外的反向平仓确认。仓位管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小，支持五种模式：固定手数、按余额百分比、按可用保证金百分比、按亏损后余额百分比和按亏损后可用保证金百分比。资金管理方面，EA使用固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），盈亏比为1:2。EA在每次新K线形成时或SignalBar为0时重新计算信号，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount标志确保数据读取失败时重新尝试。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on price channel breakout, using the PriceChannel_Stop indicator to identify trend direction changes. Entry conditions: when the upper channel buffer (buffer 3) shows a non-empty value, a buy signal is triggered; when the lower channel buffer (buffer 0) shows a non-empty value, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions include: closing sell positions when a buy signal fires, closing buy positions when a sell signal fires, and additionally using auxiliary indicator buffers (buffer 4 and buffer 1) for extra counter-direction close confirmation. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and loss-adjusted free margin percentage. Money management uses a fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. The EA recalculates signals on each new bar formation or when SignalBar is 0 to avoid repeated trades, and uses a Recount flag to retry when buffer data reads fail.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling lot size ratio or fixed lot

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式选择（固定手数/余额百分比/可用保证金百分比等）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin / balance / margin minus floating loss / balance minus floating loss / fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=已完成K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于价格通道突破，入场出场条件明确
提供5种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易风格和账户规模
使用SignalBar=1默认确认已完成K线信号，减少虚假信号
止损止盈比例1:2，具有正期望值的盈亏比设计
允许独立控制多空方向的入场和出场，灵活性高
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on price channel breakout with well-defined entry and exit conditions
Five money management modes providing flexibility for different trading styles and account sizes
Uses SignalBar=1 by default to confirm signals on completed bars, reducing false signals
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2, providing a positive risk-reward expectancy
Independent control over buy/sell entry and exit directions for high flexibility
cons: 依赖自定义指标PriceChannel_Stop，缺乏指标源代码的透明性和可验证性
ChannelPeriod=5周期较短，容易在震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动性动态调整
没有价差过滤机制，在高价差环境下可能产生不利成交
缺少持仓数量限制，可能在极端行情中同时持有多个同方向仓位
cons_en: Depends on the custom PriceChannel_Stop indicator without source code transparency or verifiability
ChannelPeriod=5 is relatively short, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Fixed stop loss of 1000 and take profit of 2000 points without dynamic adjustment for market volatility
No spread filter mechanism, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No position count limit, potentially holding multiple same-direction positions during extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈距离
添加价差过滤和时间过滤，避免在高价差和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for adaptive adjustment to market volatility
Add spread filter and time filter to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity sessions

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，在不同行情下风险暴露不一致
缺少最大持仓限制和日内亏损限制，极端行情可能造成过度亏损
短周期通道参数可能在震荡市中产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss and take profit without volatility adaptation leads to inconsistent risk exposure across different market conditions
No maximum position limit or daily loss limit, extreme market conditions could cause excessive losses
Short channel period may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
